rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides comprehensive access to over 60 Kali Linux penetration testing tools across 12 categories including reconnaissance, vulnerability scanning, web application testing, password attacks, and forensic analysis. Features an interactive PTY terminal manager for persistent sessions, a code execution engine supporting 12 programming languages, and built-in security controls including JWT authentication, input sanitization, rate limiting, and audit logging. Supports both stdio and HTTP transport modes with configurable risk levels and target whitelisting.
